lines.en: I head over to the dojo because I have a good feeling I can get Osako to accidentally kill me if I say the right things. But Ayane is there when I arrive, so I decide against it to save her the agony.
lines.zh: 我朝道场走去,因为我有种强烈的预感:只要说对话,我就能让 Osako 顺手把我弄死。但到达时 Ayane 也在,为了不让她遭这份罪,我打消了这个念头。

lines.en: I've read in books (When I used to do that) that there are people who manage to overcome their mental rainy seasons through intense physical exertion and things like going to the gym.
lines.zh: 我曾在书上读到过(在我还会读书的年代),有人能通过高强度的体力消耗、健身之类的活动,熬过自己心理上的梅雨季。

lines.en: But I quickly discern that I am not one of those people as just being here beneath these lights makes me want to lean into kicks rather than deflect them.
lines.zh: 但我很快确认自己不属于那种人——光是站在这片灯光下,我就想把身体迎向踢击而不是格挡开。

lines.en: Osako proceeds to give the two of us karate lessons, but cuts those lessons short when she realizes I'm not feeling it.
lines.zh: Osako 接着给我们两个上空手道课,但她发现我毫无状态后,便提前收了课。

lines.en: She talks to me alone and tries to hype me up, but I do nothing but stare back at her and silently wish she would have kicked me out of here years ago.
lines.zh: 她单独找我谈话,试图给我打气,但我只是回望着她,心里默默希望她几年前就把我从这里踢出去。

lines.en: Because maybe then, I wouldn't get my hopes up. And I could forget all those things I read.
lines.zh: 因为那样的话,也许我就不会抱起希望。也就能忘掉我读过的那些东西。

lines.en: Ayane left without saying goodbye today, but I don't think there was any malicious intent behind it.
lines.zh: Ayane 今天没道别就走了,但我不觉得这背后有什么恶意。

lines.en: She knows I'm fucked. And so does Osako to a certain extent, but I'm not sure if she'll ever really get it since she's never going to fall for me and has no reason to care any more than she already does.
lines.zh: 她知道我完蛋了。Osako 在某种程度上也知道,但我不确定她是否真的会懂——她永远不会爱上我,也没有理由比现在更在乎一分。

lines.en: I like that about her. I don't have to worry that this will ever turn into anything more than it actually is. And I can slip into physical stasis when I'm with her, so my mind can wander elsewhere.
lines.zh: 我喜欢她这一点。我不用担心这会变成超出它本身的东西。而且和她在一起时,我的身体会进入停滞,思绪得以飘向别处。

lines.en: I just wish it would stop wandering in the space between my lust for death and the circumstances that would allow me to seek reprieve inside of her.
lines.zh: 我只希望它别再游荡在「我对死亡的渴望」与「能让我在她体内寻求缓刑的境况」之间的那片空间里。
Osako 的好感度提升到了 [osako_love]!
